description: Anonymous US-market catalog search and complete result pagination over the observed Sephora catalog XHR. Product-detail and sale-price fields remain separate, explicit gaps. Affiliate terms are recorded independently from product API access.

capabilities.title: Search Sephora US products and read current SKU list-price data
capabilities.note: Returns currentSku.skuId as variantId and a productUrl taken from a same-origin targetUrl bound to productId/currentSku.skuId. A single list price is normalized to USD money; ranges remain explicit min/max money. listPrice is not represented as a sale price.

capabilities.title: Collect every page of a search response and verify termination against totalProducts
capabilities.note: The live sample completed pages 1–3 (60, 60, and 44 records) against totalProducts=164 with unique product IDs. The client stops at ceil(totalProducts/pageSize) and rejects count drift or duplicates.

capabilities.title: Read a Sephora product detail and option-specific prices through an anonymous API
capabilities.blocker: The observed search XHR includes products[].url as a first-party detail API candidate, but an independent cookie-free Node request timed out after 20 seconds before response headers. Direct product-page navigation also returned an Akamai Access Denied page. No reusable product-detail response, option-level price contract, or full-detail client is verified.

capabilities.title: Read current promotional or sale price separately from list price
capabilities.blocker: The observed first-party search XHR provides currentSku.listPrice and onSaleData but no salePrice amount. The sampled results reported onSaleData=NONE. No sale amount is inferred.

capabilities.title: Collect prices for a non-US Sephora market and verify its currency
capabilities.blocker: Only the US market contract and USD price formatting were independently replayed. Other country, locale, and currency mappings remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Read the current Sephora affiliate commission rate and terms
capabilities.blocker: Sephora's public affiliate page names Rakuten Advertising but does not publish a fixed numeric commission rate. The current rate depends on publisher program terms.

capabilities.title: Sign in to a customer account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The requested catalog collector uses anonymous public reads and does not need a customer login.

capabilities.title: Mutate basket, checkout, or order state
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The requested client is read-only and limited to product search and prices.

capabilities.title: Account MID -> verified Sephora US publisher catalog and returned tracking URL
capabilities.blocker: No approved publisher token or account-owned Sephora MID supplied. Exact-name/US/USD validation is implemented locally; affiliate attribution and final target are unverified.

capabilities.title: Actual commerce CLI -> price JSON/CSV with independent readback
capabilities.note: API field price kind and range preserved. Ulta sponsored cards are not identical to organic resultCount; provider_limited stays incomplete.
